entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Catastrophic event in 4557 AR that freed the Eldrazi titans from the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Hedron chamber in the Teeth of Akoum that held the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan who later migrated to Innistrad.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi and tried to reseal the prison.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Elder Dragon planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Kor lithomancer planeswalker who helped bind the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon pulling strings in the background.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spell with the Dragon Scroll destabilized the Eye.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who followed Chandra to the Eye.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who joined the confrontation at the Eye.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Animist who broke the keylock hedron to free the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: Scroll whose contents Chandra used for ghostfire.

events.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin bound the Eldrazi titans within the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: had been lured to Zendikar and bound within the Eye of Ugin

events.summary: Chandra, followed by Jace and Sarkhan, fought in the Eye and her ghostfire destabilized its enchantments.
events.quote: Chandra unleashed a powerful spell using the scroll's contents

events.summary: Sorin met Nissa and Anowon on Ondu and they agreed to travel to Akoum.
events.quote: These three agreed to travel together to Akoum

events.summary: Nissa interrupted Sorin's ritual and broke the keylock hedron needed to reseal the prison.
events.quote: Nissa interrupted Sorin's ritual, and instead broke apart the keylock hedron

events.summary: Ulamog, Kozilek and Emrakul emerged, unraveling Zendikar's natural forces.
events.quote: Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul emerged once more
Emrakul would later leave Zendikar entirely, migrating to Innistrad

relations.note: she disrupted his plan to reseal the Eldrazi

relations.quote: the vampire Sorin Markov , the Elder Dragon Ugin , and the kor lithomancer Nahiri
all three of whom engaged in a chaotic confrontation inside the chamber
